verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a SaaS memory API, so letting users subscribe to platform events via webhooks is a fair question. The only webhook mentions describe connectors (Google Drive, Notion, etc.) using real-time webhooks to auto-sync content into Supermemory. That is inbound sync, not a user-facing way to subscribe to Supermemory events such as ingestion completion or memory updates. Nothing documents outbound webhook registration, event types, or payloads.
